description: List a workspace's Foundry dashboards, pinned ones first: each a set of tiles, typed queries of ontologies' loads shown as tables and charts, which every member sees and reads as themselves. Specs are left out: helix_foundry_get_dashboard reads one.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_list_dashboards

publish_block.description: Why you may not publish it at a public link, when can_publish is false: admin_only (only owners and admins do), workspace_off (an owner turned public links off for the workspace) or unavailable (this host has none).

revision.description: What update_dashboard, pin_dashboard and publish_dashboard name as expected_revision.

expires_at.description: When the link stops showing the snapshot; left out: never.

published.description: Always true: the dashboard has a public link, which its page in Foundry shows owners and admins. No tool returns the link.

spec_revision.description: The dashboard's revision the snapshot shows: older than its revision after an edit, until it is published again.

status.description: live (the link shows the snapshot), expired (publishing again makes a new link), workspace_off (an owner turned public links off for the workspace) or unavailable (this host has none). Only live shows anything.

spec.description: Untrusted dashboard spec: its tiles and layout. Left out of a list. An integer past 2^53 in a query comes as a string of its digits: write it back as a number.

url.description: Its page in Foundry: how to share it inside the workspace. Every member who opens it signs in and reads it as themselves, live.

title: List Foundry dashboards
